As a software engineer migrating GRXML grammars to Microsoft Copilot Studio, analyze GRXML files and classify them as:

1) Prebuilt entity (from: Age, Boolean, City, Color, Continent, Country, Date, Date and time, Date and time without timezone, Duration, Email, Event, File, Language, Money, Number, Ordinal, Organization, Percentage, Person name, Phone number, Point of interest, Speed, State, Street address, Temperature, URL, Weight, Zip code)

2) Custom entity (ClosedListEntity: list of interchangeable synonyms; RegexEntity: regular expressions)

You will receive GRXML content along with a file name. Analyze the content and provide your response. 

 Always explicitly transfer ALL alternate phrases or synonyms provided in GRXML exactly as they appear, even if they are similar to the entity ID. Do NOT omit any synonyms that differ even slightly from the entity ID. Carefully check each synonym for spacing, spelling, punctuation, different abbreviation forms, acronyms, underscores, or hyphenation differences. When the spoken synonym exactly matches the ID, do NOT include this exact match in the synonyms list, but continue including all other synonyms explicitly. Verify your YAML again carefully that no GRXML-provided synonym or slight variation has been omitted.

Example 1:
File name: auth7561_IDVConfPhNum_QA.grxml
Grxml input: 
    <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<grammar version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/06/grammar" xml:lang="en-US" root="eIDVConfPhNumYN" mode="voice">
    <rule id="eIDVConfPhNumYN" scope="public">
        <one-of>
            <item>
                <ruleref uri="#YES"/>
                <tag>eIDVConfPhNumYN="yes";</tag>
            </item>
            <item>
                <ruleref uri="#NO"/>
                <tag>eIDVConfPhNumYN="no";</tag>
            </item>
        </one-of>
    </rule>
    <rule id="YES" scope="private">
        <one-of>
            <item>yes</item>
            <item>yeah</item>
            <item>yep</item>
            <item>yup</item>
            <item>sure</item>
            <item>right</item>
            <item>correct</item>
            <item>okay</item>
            <item>affirmative</item>
        </one-of>
    </rule>
    <rule id="NO" scope="private">
        <one-of>
            <item>no</item>
            <item>nope</item>
            <item>absolutely not</item>
            <item>wrong</item>
            <item>negative</item>
            <item>that's not correct</item>
            <item>that is not right</item>
        </one-of>
    </rule>
</grammar>


Output in pure YAML as follows:
entity_type: CustomListEntity
reason: although the GRXML input represents a Boolean, you should make it a CustomListEntity to enable multiple synonyms for the answers 'yes' and 'no'.
copilot_studio_code: |
    - kind: CustomEntityComponent
        displayName: auth7561_IDVConfPhNum_QA
        state: Active
        status: Active
        schemaName: auth7561_IDVConfPhNum_QA
        entity:
        kind: ClosedListEntity
        items:
            - id: YES
            displayName: YES
            synonyms:
                - yeah
                - yep
                - yup
                - sure
                - right
                - correct
                - okay
                - affirmative
            - id: NO
            displayName: NO
            synonyms:
                - nope
                - absolutely
                - wrong
                - negative
                - that's not correct
                - that is not right
            - id: MAYBE_NO
            displayName: MAYBE NO
            synonyms:
                - maybe nope
                - maybe absolutely
                - maybe wrong
                - maybe negative
                - maybe that's not correct
                - maybe that is not right


Note that the words 'yes' and 'no' must not be repeated in the synonyms.

        displayName: bom0310_DisambPharmacyMenu_QA_dtmf

            synonyms: 1
            - id: check_prescription_status
            displayName: check_prescription_status

            displayName: inquire_hours
            synonyms: 3

displayName: transfer_pharmacy
            synonyms: 4
